component.name: Ocarina2
component.summary: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on the Lichii emulator

description.p: Ocarina2 is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time edition of Lichii, the experimental open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator fork based on Eglantine and Eden, with work inherited from yuzu and Sudachi. Compatibility and performance vary by game and hardware.
